integrity: The theorem is proved analytically; an exact-rational standard-library checker provides finite corroboration. The originality comparison is bounded to documented sources, and no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proof concerns strictly positive rates on one-directional directed cycles of at least three states, theta in [0,1], exact single-step probability preservation; no extension to arbitrary generators, internal stages, embeddability, or solver accuracy is claimed.
title: A stationary-mass threshold for positivity of the theta method on heterogeneous directed cycles
